readme.heading: Reading order for a bot
readme.markdown:
1. Official kit sections (staff, verbatim numbers) in the spec file — these are the only "true" values.
2. Rotation/priority lists — each step carries the kit version it was written for.
3. Contested markers — do not resolve them; present both sides.
4. Gaps below — answer "the forum does not say" rather than inventing.

readme.heading: Gaps (known unknowns — never guess these)
readme.markdown:
Talents and builds
- No source lists a complete 51-point build for any spec talent by talent. All builds are opaque `talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=...` strings (armsgirl p=157920 ×4, Inovatu p=118692, Ademar p=103539, Czasku p=106723 ×2, Yasara p=108095) that cannot be decoded from the repo. Unassigned points are marked in each playbook.
- Fury-prot post-CC2 allocation: only "Death Wish + Improved Shield Slam" (Xudo p=114018).
- Exact level at which each talent is taken: armsgirl's route gives order only; levels in `leveling.md` are the reader's arithmetic.
- Blood Craze in raids (Atreidon "3 points down the drain" vs Abiozan "must take"), Unbridled Wrath for 2H, Defensive Tactics — contested, unresolved.

Numbers
- Stat weights: none published for any spec. WarriorSim (Ugoboom p=35760 / wiki link) and the rentry guide (Muck5955 p=156287) are named but not in the repo.
- Hit cap on Turtle's smoothed weapon-skill formula: 9% boss / 5% dungeon is repeated by players (Reploidrocsa, Tomberry) with "8% max" for 2H (Cheruscan p=156442) — no staff confirmation.
- Defense/crit-immunity and crush numbers: Ellifta's 370 Defense observation only.
- Flurry's current attack-speed value (Bigsmerf "15%") — no staff line.
- Rage formula constants after CC2 ("90% gear / 10% weapon speed") — staff description without formula.
- PvP dampening per-class numbers for 1.18.1 — staff said "at a later date"; not in the repo.
- Respec gold cost — "cheap" only.
- Deep Wounds bug (Cromius p=149915: ticks ~35% instead of 60%) — unresolved in the extracted posts.

Rotation/mechanics
- AoE thresholds (when Whirlwind/Cleave beats single-target) — not stated for any spec.
- Whether post-CC2 fury-prot tanks in Defensive or Berserker Stance.
- Whirlwind with a shield equipped (asked, not answered).
- Whether absorb shields still give zero rage post-1.18.1 (Snoof complaint, pre-1.18.1).
- Rank-5 Shield Slam scaling details beyond "20% AP, 75% threat" (1.18.1 notes).
- Slam/Flurry post-hotfix behaviour (2026-03-21 "Flurry will now properly be consumed") — no player follow-up.

Gear/consumables
- No enchant list beyond "stamina enchants" (PvP) and no consumable list beyond FAP/tea/sugar/reflectors; raid consumables are vanilla baseline, not from turtlecraft.gg.
- Pre-BiS/BiS lists: named threads (Bigsmerf p=134748, Noephix p=135325) point to Atlas Loot / external sheets, not itemized in the forum.
- The "Lionheart Helmet" stamina change in the 1.18.0 itemization post (p=137624) is the Paladin T3.5 set, not the warrior helm — do not conflate.

Era coverage
- Post-1.18.1 (2026-03-20 .. shutdown): Warrior forum has only leveling chatter, one PvP complaint thread, Berettadin's execute note, SvenS2's Unbridled Wrath suggestion and the Flurry hotfix. No post-1.18.1 raid parses, no re-evaluated tank ranking, no re-evaluated PvP after the Hamstring cooldown removal.
- Roles without sources: healer, ranged (not warrior roles); 2H Fury leveling after CC3 (one HC anecdote).

Unresolved citations
- None remaining: the two previously unresolved quotes in `protection-tank.md` are now attributed (Lavrute p=113482 for "thunder clap by default usable in defensive stance"; Ademar p=103539 for the CC2-launch prot build link).

playbooks.title: Warrior — Protection — Tank ("deep prot", sword and board)
playbooks.intro:
The 31+-point Protection build with a one-hander and shield. The Fury/Prot hybrid tank is a separate playbook (`fury-tank.md`); Arms-based dungeon tanking while leveling is in `leveling.md`.

Eras: pre-1.18.1 (before 2025-10-03), 1.18.1-announced-pre-release (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), post-1.18.1 (from 2026-03-20). Kit revisions: CC2 (1.17.2, 2024-11-01), Dec-2024 revision, CC3 (1.18.0, 2025-08-15), 1.18.1.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: main tank / off tank in dungeons and raids. Staff intent: "improving Protection leveling builds and opening up new builds for end-game, Shield Slam ... has gained significant damage scaling, and ... the lower half of the tree has been jazzed up with many new threat and damage options" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974). Staff in Jan 2026: "Protection Warriors have been falling behind other tanks. These changes provide targeted improvements, while a more comprehensive review of the Protection talent tree and overall kit is planned for the future" [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071).
- **Strengths (sources)**: best mitigation toolkit — Shield Block makes you crit- and crush-immune for the blocked hits ("You are literally critimmune if you are under effect of Shield Block and have usual warrior avoidance stats" [Xudo (player), 2023-03-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=38228#p38228); "crit and crush immunity if using shield block and shield slam on CD and 10% less damage taken" [Ellifta (player), 2025-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115882#p115882)); Shield Wall, Last Stand, Disarm, Shield Slam dispel; the go-to progression tank because tier sets are tank sets and MC drops tank gear ("warriors are the go-to tank for progression raids. even in mostly blue gear they can still tank most of the MC bosses" [Zulnam (player), 2024-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103027#p103027)); fear bosses and Maexxna/Loatheb are "just much easier with a warrior than a feral" [Atreidon (player), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102946#p102946); "warrior tanks are good. Their threat generation provides the best gameplay where actually threat management is a thing" [Calli (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113382#p113382).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: single-target threat behind bear and paladin after CC2 ("It's common knowledge by now that warrior tank is severely lacking compared to other tanks in threat department" [Ellifta (player), 2026-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167684#p167684); "A bear in dungeons blues can rip threat from a t3 thunderfury protection tank effortlessly without even using taunt" [Bobguy (player), 2025-08-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142932#p142932); "Paladin has a 262.5% threat modifier on holy strike and bear has a whopping 523% of his damage dealth as threat on savage bite" [Atreidon (player), 2024-11-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=110503#p110503)); weak AoE threat (Thunder Clap "does 100 damage at max rank without any scaling" [Licata (player), 2026-01-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166667#p166667); "no real AoE threat like other tanks" [Morkahja (player), 2026-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167180#p167180)); threat concentrated in Shield Slam so a parried/dodged Shield Slam (boss front: "14% parry chance + a 6.5% dodge chance") is "a devastating loss ... for at least 4.5s" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-03-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170786#p170786) (Xudo replies you still have Revenge and Sunder [Xudo (player), 2026-03-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170939#p170939) — contested); rage starvation when avoidance is high ("when you dodge/parry you get nothing" [Xronisf79 (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=85027#p85027)); Shield Block and Improved Shield Slam's block buff overwrite each other instead of stacking ("They cancel each other out" [Ellifta (player), 2026-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167684#p167684); [Eyeburn (player), 2026-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169309#p169309)); tier sets lack block value + crit together ("none of the warrior tier sets have both of these stats in the same set" [Ellifta (player), 2026-01-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164933#p164933)).
- **Content**: dungeons — fine but "you don't need to invest a single point into the prot tree until late game" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175303#p175303); raids — main tank for MC–BWL progression and fear/Maexxna-type fights; late raids (Naxx/Kara40) contested vs bear/paladin; PvP — a meme spec with a niche (stuns, Shield Slam dispel, 7k HP) [Manletow (player), 2024-12-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112703#p112703); hardcore — favored for dungeon-only leveling (see `leveling.md`).
- **Community standing**: **contested** through 2024–2026. Positive: "Sword and board warrior is the meta now. Shieldslam runs laps around bloodthirst when it comes to threat ... for 40 man raids, sword and board is the way to go now. More threat and more survivability!" [Atreidon (player), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108893#p108893) (raid leader of a "content Clear guild" who moved two fury-tank MTs to sword and board [p=108957](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108957#p108957)); "Deep Prot's threat generation after CC2 is higher than Furry Prot's" [Herods (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130503#p130503); "is that why speedruns bring warrior tanks?" [amanagor (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112552#p112552). Negative: "warrior is currently the worst tank of the game. You're actually gimping your raid to even bring one unless they are an outstanding tank. Druids and paladins are the meta now" [Biteyou (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112545#p112545); "our GM in Mortality swapped over to Druid because warrior is in such a bad state for tanking" [Gildark (player), 2024-12-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112686#p112686); "deep prot is a dead spec and even dtactics is garbage" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169309#p169309). Bots: a prot warrior is always accepted as a dungeon tank; in raids expect to be compared with bears/paladins on threat and to be asked to tank fear/single-target bosses.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- **Defense** to remove crits; "With 370 defence in Naxx, in my experience this leads to 1 crit per boss fight and usually 4-5 crushing blows" *in Battle Stance without Shield Block* [Ellifta (player), 2025-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115882#p115882). Exact cap: not stated on Turtle ("Linearizing Weapon Skill vs Defense Skill" was announced [dev blog, 2024-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?t=13840); numbers gap). Vanilla baseline (not from turtlecraft.gg): 440 defense removes boss crits.
- **Hit and weapon skill** matter because warrior threat "relies primarily on white hits" and Sunder/Revenge/Shield Slam can miss/be parried: "weaponskill is therefor invaluable to a warrior tank" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-07-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=142315#p142315); +5% hit from talents was a repeated wish [Calli (player), 2024-06-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=97903#p97903). Weapon skill does not reduce boss parry (Xudo quoting Daaki, Fury playbook).
- **Stamina / effective health** and armor for raid bosses ("Being fan of Effective Health ... reach minimum required defense cap and then invest into EH" [Bogyone (player), 2024-01-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=85806#p85806)); tank gear at 7k unbuffed is cited for PvP prot (Manletow).
- **Block value + crit** is what deep prot "was meant to be itemized around" (Ellifta, T2 thread) — Shield Slam scales with block value and AP.
- **Dungeon set**: "having a specific Dungeon Tanking set really feels great" — T1 + dungeon blues for rage income [Zahnfee (player), 2024-01-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=85564#p85564); more avoidance = less rage.
- Leveling: Stamina, then whatever gives rage; see `leveling.md`.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (boss)
rotationSingle.markdown:
Kit: Dec-2024 → 1.18.1 (Revenge 6 s CD, Shield Slam 6 s minus 1.5 s talented, Concussion Blow 20 s / 0 rage / +10 rage, Improved Shield Slam 4.5 s block buff).

**Opener**: (Charge in Battle Stance if pulling → Defensive Stance with Tactical Mastery) or ranged pull; **Bloodrage** before the pull (it puts you in combat and gives rage; "/cast Bloodrage /yell I AM RANGE PULLING ... /cast Shoot" [Gdawg45 (player), 2022-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=31058#p31058)); first GCDs: **Concussion Blow → Shield Slam** ("opening with Concussion Blow + Shield Slam would result in significantly more threat" [Taralej90 (player), 2025-08-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146132#p146132); staff design: Concussion Blow "used for maximizing single target opener/snap threat as the first global cooldown"), then **Sunder Armor** to 5 and **Demoralizing Shout** early ("Early in the encounter is it recommended to use Demoralizing Shout to reduce damage taken and to generate threat" — Gdawg45).

**Priority**:
1. **Shield Slam** on cooldown (biggest threat; also 50% (+25/50% Gag Order) magic dispel).
2. **Revenge** whenever available after a block/dodge/parry (Reprisal refunds the rage; "If you hit a mob with a revenge you will not lose aggro 99% of the time" [Sixgun (player), 2023-04-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=41025#p41025)). Revenge needs Defensive Stance.
3. **Shield Block** on cooldown for crit/crush immunity and a guaranteed Revenge ("Shield block gives you a guaranteed revenge proc, it is worth it, use it" — Sixgun); mind the overwrite with Improved Shield Slam's block buff: "You should not have to play piano and watch whether boss managed to hit you or not to be crush immune" (Ellifta) — in practice use Shield Block right after the Improved-Shield-Slam charge has been consumed, or accept the overwrite.
4. **Sunder Armor** until 5 stacks, then as the filler ("Then, when I have rage, sunder... You spend 10-2 rage..." — Xudo on low-level Shield Block; sunder-spam is the accepted deep-prot filler: "I'm spamming sunder" [Matches (player), 2024-12-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114231#p114231)).
5. **Heroic Strike** as the rage dump at high rage (on next swing; "If you are using Heroic Strike as a tank, you are dumping rage" — Arkaris); Improved Heroic Strike is why some take 3 Arms points.
6. **Concussion Blow** on cooldown after the opener (20 s; free rage since CC3) — it is threat, not only a stun (boss-immune to the stun but "does twice the amount of threat when the target is immune" was only a player wish [Isvya (player), 2024-11-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=109791#p109791)).
7. Thunder Clap once per pull for the attack-speed debuff (usable in Defensive Stance).
8. Execute phase: with Defensive Tactics swap to Battle/Berserker Stance and spam Execute ("This talent allows you to exit def stance and spam execute when boss has less than 20% of hp" [Xudo (player), 2025-01-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115711#p115711)); Eyeburn notes threat is rarely an issue at that point anyway.

**Defensive Tactics stance choice** (Ellifta, 2025-01-08): Battle Stance = "+7-8% more threat gained per point of damage dealt compared to defensive stance, 10% more damage ... roughly ends up to 15-20% more threat overall", Overpower/Execute available, but no Shield Block crit/crush immunity — use on threat-critical bosses ("Vaelstratz or Maexna"); Defensive Stance = crit/crush immune, 10% less damage taken — "twin emps, Chromaggus or Patchwerk"; Berserker Stance = +3% crit, Whirlwind for AoE threat, fear immunity via Berserker Rage. Math: Defensive Stance with Defiance 5/5 = 1.30 × 1.15 = 1.495 threat per damage; with Defensive Tactics 3/3 in another stance = (1.495 − 1) × 1.8 + 1 = 1.891, times the hidden 0.8 Battle/Berserker threat modifier = 1.512 [Ellifta (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156473#p156473) (measured with TWThreat 1.3; 1.18.1 Defiance 20% changes the numbers — not recomputed by anyone). Whether Whirlwind can be used with a shield equipped is contested in one thread (Captain4k no / Morkahja "I use it often" [Morkahja (player), 2026-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167704#p167704)).

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets (dungeon pack)**: Charge the first → Defensive Stance → **Thunder Clap** ("For AoE tanking you do want to spam tclap as your main aoe threat generator ... tabbing sunder is no longer necessary nor recommended" [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47322#p47322); the thread's other voice: "Some dudes say that you can charge in and literally spam tclap ... Viable, however, not optimal" [Sinrek (player), 2023-09-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=61271#p61271)) → **Demoralizing Shout** ("Demo Shout does help with threat in AoE pulls" — Sixgun) → tab through mobs with Revenge/Sunder/Shield Slam: "For the rest of the engagement I tab between the mobs and use Revenge as much as possible while using Shield Block on CD" (Gdawg45); "Use a threat meter, tabbing between targets mid-fight to decide where you are low, and which mob needs another revenge/sunder" (Sixgun). Whirlwind in Berserker Stance with Defensive Tactics is an AoE-threat option (Xudo, Morkahja). Cleave on next swing with 2+ targets.
- **4+ targets**: Thunder Clap (4-target cap per Theeviltpot: "an instant attack that hits 4 people" [Theeviltpot (player), 2026-02-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167206#p167206)), Demoralizing Shout, Challenging Shout as the emergency AoE taunt (Xudo, below); accept that paladins/bears do it better; ask for CC and mark the kill order.
- Skull macro / mark kill order so DPS stack on one target: "making a macro that notifies the party of the kill order"; "mark current target with skull ... build some threat on skull, tab target to other enemies, use 1 or 2 skills and go back to skull" [Reploidrocsa (player), 2023-09-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=62793#p62793).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- **Taunt chain**: "You have 3 Taunt-like abilities. First is taunt. Second is Mocking Blow. Third is Challenging Shout. At level 30 you also get Intercept. When I lose agro and mob run away from me, then I switch to berserker stance, use Intercept, switch to Defensive Stance and use Taunt. It all takes 1 GCD ... When my Taunt is on CD, I switch to Battle Stance and use Mocking blow. When everyting is on CD, I use challenging shout" [Xudo (player), 2023-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40901#p40901). Taunt macro: `/run if not UnitIsUnit('player','targettarget') then CastSpellByName('Taunt'); end` + `/cast Shield Block` (Gdawg45). Intervene to reach a healer who pulled aggro [Akos1896 (player), 2025-01-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=116000#p116000); Improved Intervene gives snare immunity.
- **Shield Wall / Last Stand**: emergency; Shield Wall shares the 30-min cooldown with Recklessness/Retaliation and ends if you remove the shield (staff); Improved Shield Wall −5/10 min.
- **Shield Block**: on cooldown when tanking bosses; not needed in low-level dungeons ("You spend 10-2 rage to reduce next attack damage for about 40 points. I think it don't worth it" [Xudo (player), 2023-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40901#p40901)) — Sixgun disagrees (guaranteed Revenge). Contested at low level, consensus at 60.
- **Berserker Rage** for fears (stance dance; Tactical Mastery).
- **Rage**: Bloodrage on cooldown / before pulls; **conserve rage at the end of a pull for the next one** ("Conserve your rage, if you are towards the end of a fight/pull, everything is going fine, then stop using abilities and save that rage for the next pull" — Sixgun; "Best you can do on a rage tank is get in the habit of 'saving' some rage between pulls" [Bob022 (player), 2023-04-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=40865#p40865)); more avoidance/tier gear = less rage, hence the T1-set/dungeon-set advice and the fury-prot temptation; absorb shields on you or the target reduce rage income (Fury playbook). Orc tanks: "DO NOT USE THE RACIAL AS IT WILL REDUCE THE HEALING ON YOU" (Gdawg45; the CC2 Blood Fury has −25% healing 25 s per [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974) racial notes quoted in thread).
- **Downtime**: watch party mana before pulling ("I will usually feel comfortable pulling if everyone is 50% or more mana" — Gdawg45).

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- **Positioning/pulling**: pull back to the group; "You can keep your group back a ways from your pulls and backwards-walk your pulls as you bring them in, allowing you crucial seconds to build a threat lead" (Bob022); line-of-sight pulls for casters; face mobs away from the party; control runner direction — "ALL Runners Run AWAY FROM Whatever Holds Their Aggro" so stand so the line through the mob ends at a wall, never at another pack [Roxanneflowers (player), 2020-07-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=7046#p7046).
- **Interrupts**: Shield Bash on casters, especially heals ("If it attempts to heal itself I shield bash it AS FAST AS POSSIBLE" — Gdawg45); at low level Shield Bash is also the best threat button ("Shield Bash generates 180 bonus threat at all levels ... your opener as a tank, for only 10 rage" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-05-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47619#p47619)); Pummel in Battle/Berserker stance; Concussion Blow as a second interrupt on casters.
- **Leadership**: mark targets, call CC, communicate ("the tank job does often demand a pretty good typing ability" — Bob022); let a suicidal DPS die rather than the healer ("Some people can't be saved because they do stupid things. Let them die and keep your healer safe" — Xudo).
- **Threat management**: use a threat meter (TWThreat — Ellifta); build a lead before DPS opens ("condition dps to only start attacking AFTER the tank has established a threat buffer" [Cheruscan (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170673#p170673)); if a Shield Slam is parried at the pull, be ready to Taunt (Xudo).
- **Raid assignments**: fear bosses (Onyxia, Magmadar, Nefarian, Yauj, Gluth) and Maexxna/Loatheb go to the warrior (Atreidon); bring a shield even as fury-prot for those (`fury-tank.md`).
- **Camera/targets**: max camera distance, Tab through adjacent targets, keybind marks (Xudo, Bob022); UnitXP addon for "smart targeting" [Bordar (player), 2025-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135485#p135485).
- Gear swaps by stance with Outfitter or Roid-Macros `/equip` `/equipoh` (macro threads, `leveling.md`).

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown:
- Tier: "You should never ever wear full T1, T2 or T3 if you want to hold threat against people with purple gear ... stick with T2 shoulders ... T2 legs and boots are also strong ... use off-pieces like ES helmet instead of T2 helmet or T2 DPS chest instead of T2 tank chest" [Ellifta (player), 2026-01-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164933#p164933) (single source, Kara40-geared prot main); T1 set bonus gives rage ("now that i got the set bonus from the T1 i have plenty of rage" [Xronisf79 (player), 2024-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=85704#p85704)); "they changed warrior tanks so that original t1, t2 and t3 are not crap anymore" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135310#p135310); Kara40 T3.5 is one mixed set for both roles — repeated complaint, no staff answer [Davdes1 (player), 2025-06-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=133988#p133988).
- Weapons: Thunderfury for threat (the proc's slow only on the main target; damage jumps contested) [t=22555]; "Deep prot with tundetfury counter enh shaman" (PvP) [ferundal (player), 2026-02-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168167#p168167).
- Shield spikes: "Thorium Shield spike ... Each use blocks damage twice and damages opponent twice for only 10 rage" (pre-CC2, when Shield Block had 2 charges) [Unangwata (player), 2020-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8311#p8311).
- Lifegiving Gem (BWL) for PvP/HP (Terrydavis, Springboards — `arms-pvp.md`).
- Royal Seal of Eldre'thalas (Warrior): 30 AP + 8 Defense [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276).
- Consumables/enchants: gap — no prot-specific list in the Warrior forum.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Going deep Prot before 60 and expecting it to help: "Prior to raids, you do not need to be Prot in order to tank well" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37550#p37550) (consensus; see `leveling.md`).
- Spamming Heroic Strike as a prot filler instead of Sunder/Revenge/Shield Slam (Arkaris, Matches); HS swings give no rage.
- Skipping Demoralizing Shout / Thunder Clap on packs (Roxanneflowers, Sixgun, SvenS2: "Cast demo shout, spam sunder and don't rely too much on thunderclap").
- Dumping all rage at the end of a pull (Sixgun, Bob022).
- Tanking in Battle Stance with Defensive Tactics on hard-hitting bosses (loses Shield Block immunity — Ellifta's own caveat: "1 crit per boss fight and usually 4-5 crushing blows").
- Overwriting Improved Shield Slam's block charge with Shield Block carelessly (Ellifta, Eyeburn).
- Orc Blood Fury while tanked/healed (Gdawg45).
- Chasing every runner / pointing runners at the next pack (Roxanneflowers).
- Fighting the healer's mana: pulling below 50% healer mana (Gdawg45).
- Using Taunt on cooldown "for threat" — Taunt is a fix, not a threat tool; Improved Taunt "for losers" (Xudo) / for new tanks (Xudo 2022).

extraSections.heading: Official kit (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
- CC2 [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974): Improved Bloodrage row 1 (+5/10 instant rage); Shield Specialization +1–5 rage per block; Anticipation 3 ranks 7/14/20 Defense; **Improved Shield Block removed** (power moved to Improved Shield Slam); Toughness also +3–15% shield absorption; new Improved Intervene (50/100% snare immunity 3 s after Intervene); Improved Taunt row 3; Improved Revenge also −0.5/1/1.5 s Revenge cooldown; Defiance row 4; Improved Sunder Armor removed, Sunder 10 rage; Gag Order (ex Improved Shield Bash, row 4; Shield Slam +25/50% dispel chance); Improved Disarm −10/20 s; One-Handed Weapon Specialization row 5; **Shield Slam row 5 (talentable at 30), damage modified by AP and block value**; **Improved Shield Slam** (−0.5/1 s cooldown; +35/70% block chance for the next attack within 5 s); **Reprisal** (Revenge +25/50% damage, 50/100% rage refund); Improved Shield Wall row 6 (−5/10 min, +1/2 s); **Defensive Tactics** (retain 50/100/150% of Defensive Stance's threat bonus in other stances while wearing a shield); **Concussion Blow row 7** (damage, high threat, armor penetration). Baseline: Shield Wall ends if you unequip the shield; Thunder Clap usable in Defensive Stance (earlier Turtle change referenced by players: "Since turtle added thunder clap by default usable in defensive stance" [Lavrute (player), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113482#p113482)).
- 2024-10-21 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=104207#p104207): Improved Shield Slam 4.5 s duration/cooldown, −0.75/1.5 s Shield Slam cooldown.
- 2024-11-01 [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105804#p105804): Defensive Tactics 55/110/165%.
- 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): **Concussion Blow 20 s cooldown, 100% armor penetration, 2 s stun** ("a very strong threat opener for tanks"); **Defensive Tactics 60/120/180%** ("allow tanks wearing shields to sacrifice mitigation for more threat by swapping in and out of Defensive Stance"); **Revenge cooldown 6 s** ("Revenge, and Shield Slam and all Execute variations shall now be able to align with the GCD"); "Protection, especially Deep Protection ... we're giving it some love in the deep talents".
- 2025-03-30 [Torta (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=124504#p124504): Concussion Blow stun 3 s.
- CC3 [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159): **Concussion Blow costs no rage and generates 10 rage** ("improving its utility, especially in the early moments of a pull when Rage is scarce").
- 1.18.1 [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071): **Defiance 4/8/12/15/20%** (was 3–15%); **Shield Slam AP scaling 15% → 20% and threat modifier 50% → 75%**.
- Player-measured: Shield Slam ~0.25–0.3 AP (Dec-2024 kit) [Ivgas (player), 2025-01-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115927#p115927); Concussion Blow 235 base + ~0.15 AP, bypasses armor, and One-Handed Weapon Specialization does not multiply it consistently across stances [rubixluffy (player), 2025-01-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115195#p115195); Shield Slam rank 5 (342–359) exists in the database but only rank 4 (303–318, level 54) is trainable [Anrissa (player), 2025-08-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144636#p144636) (unanswered); Shield Slam threat modifier is not copied by Sweeping Strikes [Atreidon (player), 2026-02-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167790#p167790).
- **One-Handed Weapon Specialization only boosts auto-attack (white) damage**, not abilities — "How it works now is that only your autoswing damage is increased" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-02-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=169310#p169310), corroborated "this talent ... only affects our auto-attacks (and HS) and ignores Shield Slam and Revenge" [Taralej90 (player), 2025-08-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=146132#p146132). Consensus among players; no staff reply.

playbooks.title: Warrior — Arms — Melee DPS (raid / dungeon, two-handed)
playbooks.intro:
Two-handed Arms (Mortal Strike + Slam) as a PvE damage spec. Turtle's Class Changes 2 deliberately made Arms "the true home of twohanded Slam builds" so that "Arms builds function into raiding" [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974). Dual-wield Fury and 2H Fury are in `fury-melee-dps.md`; Arms PvP is in `arms-pvp.md`; Arms as the leveling / dungeon-tank spec is in `leveling.md`.

Eras and kit revisions as defined in `fury-melee-dps.md` (CC2 2024-11-01, Dec-2024 revision, CC3 2025-08-15, 1.18.1 2026-03-20).

overview.heading: Overview
overview.markdown:
- **Role**: melee DPS with a two-hander; brings Mortal Strike (healing debuff — noted as not affecting monster healing pre-CC2: "The very first thing we need is to make Mortal strike debuff work on monster healing. Because currently it doesn't" [Noephix (player), 2023-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=80961#p80961) — no later source says it was changed) and Sweeping Strikes cleave.
- **Strengths (sources)**: strong on add-heavy fights — "definitely better than fury in AQ40 and especially Kara40 where every boss has bazillion adds" [Ellifta (player), 2025-07-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=139087#p139087); less gear-dependent than Fury ("fury in general is more gear dependant than arms" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156442#p156442)); Mortal Strike "scales with weapon damage which is easier to keep up with good weapon progression" [Khagrim (player), 2024-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107379#p107379); big early 2H weapons (Untamed Blade, Bonereaver's Edge) "let you hit closer to your ceiling of dps much sooner than a dw warrior" [Econrel (player), 2024-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100900#p100900); best dungeon/leveling tank-DPS hybrid via Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind (see `leveling.md`).
- **Weaknesses (sources)**: rage-starved execute phase and a talent tree with a "floating 1" point problem: "Arms ... generates rage once every 3+ seconds so, barring Windfury, it can't Execute more often than that ... after you Execute you have 0 rage" [Licata (player), 2026-01-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166667#p166667); "buying 5 points in Tactical Mastery (a must/tax), 2 points in Imp. Rend (definitely a tax) and 2 points in Imp. Charge ... then needing to spend one more point to get to Tier 3 Talents. That one point has no good options" [Berettadin (player), 2026-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171710#p171710); Deep Wounds reported ticking at ~35% instead of 60% weapon damage [Cromius (player), 2025-09-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149915#p149915); Master Strike's weapon-swap mechanic is clunky (Licata, above); 1.18.1 moved Precision Cut behind Boundless Anger, which players call a nerf ("Have fun dropping Master of Arms so you can still grab Enrage. Have fun when 30/21 to grab deathwish turns out to be the superior build" [Eyeburn (player), 2026-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170636#p170636)).
- **Content**: raids — **alternative** (2023–early 2025: "just for fun" / "Arms just doesnt work compared to fury" [Likaleo (player), 2024-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95025#p95025); mid-2025 onward: "up there with fury" (Ellifta) / "already the best DPS spec in game. Check out turtlogs" [Noephix (player), 2025-06-11](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=135319#p135319) / "The spec already underperforms in pve" [Bettargh (player), 2026-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=170733#p170733) — **contested**). Dungeons — favored (Sweeping Strikes). Leveling — favored (see `leveling.md`). PvP — the class's PvP spec (Mortal Strike).
- **Community standing**: pre-CC2 "the least good DPS spec of warrior" [Bigsmerf (player), 2024-05-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94981#p94981) with social friction ("problems would start even at pugs, asking why you're not fury ... Retris ... might accuse you of ninjaing their 2h weapon upgrade for a meme" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-05-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=95042#p95042)); post-CC2 accepted, with the AQ40/Kara40 niche.

stats.heading: Stat priority
stats.markdown:
- Hit: 2H needs less than DW — "you need 8% max" [Cheruscan (player), 2025-10-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=156442#p156442) (single source); weapon skill lowers the yellow cap (see Fury playbook). "Warriors and rogues dont go for the insane 27% hitcap for dualwielding" [Atreidon (player), 2024-11-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108914#p108914) (vanilla-baseline remark).
- Weapon: the slowest, highest top-end two-hander; "Make sure your weapons are as slow as possible" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); but Slam is normalized since Dec 2024, so slow weapons lost ~18% Slam damage (staff, above). Whirlwind/Sweeping Strikes/Cleave use one auto-attack's worth of damage per target, so top-end matters [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101831#p101831). Mortal Strike "will be bigger with slow weapon than with fast weapon" [Czasku (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101834#p101834).
- Strength/AP over agility; crit matters for Impale/Deep Wounds/Overpower (Czasku, above). Exact weights: gap (no sim supports 2H Slam — Ugoboom, Fury playbook).
- Stamina for PvP variant (see `arms-pvp.md`).

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target rotation (raid)
rotationSingle.markdown:
From [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122609#p122609) and follow-ups; kit = Dec-2024 (Slam continues swing timer, Hamstring on 6 s CD, Precision Cut refund). Marked where later patches change it.

**Opener**: Charge → (Bloodrage) → Sunder Armor once on raid bosses (see Fury playbook, Atreidon) → Berserker Stance.

**Stance**: "You should be in Berserker Stance all the time to benefit from the extra Crit ... Battle Stance offers nothing" (Wolf of Rage). Caveat: Overpower needs Battle Stance; the thread treats stance-dancing for Overpower as optional.

**Priority** (target > 20%):
1. **Mortal Strike** on cooldown.
2. **Whirlwind** on cooldown ("cycling MS/WW" — Wolf of Rage).
3. **Overpower** whenever the target dodged (Battle Stance only; "Overpower is also only available if ever your opponent performs a Dodge").
4. **Slam** as the filler when MS and WW are down, cast immediately after a white swing: "the increased Cast Time of 2.5s (untalented) or 2s (Improved Slam 2/2) means that you will almost always have to use it just about immediately upon swinging. You may have enough time for one Ability (1 GCD, 1.5s wait time), but that may vary a lot" (Wolf of Rage). Swing-timer addon strongly implied; a `st_timer`-based macro exists [Tacticalnelf (player), 2024-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100433#p100433).
5. **Sunder Armor** as the instant filler until 5 stacks / when the tank isn't a warrior [Atreidon (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122809#p122809); on trash only to 50% HP [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122819#p122819).
6. **Hamstring** as the instant proc-fishing filler (Sword spec / Hand of Justice / Windfury) — 6 s CD pre-1.18.1, **no cooldown after 1.18.1**. "Hamstring is also the only one that can proc Sword Specialization from Master of Arms. Sunder cannot." [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-04-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=125218#p125218) — contested by armsgirl (Fury playbook).
7. **Heroic Strike** only at ≥ 70 rage with nothing else available (Wolf of Rage); "Arms doesn't want to use Heroic Strike" [Berettadin (player), 2026-03-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171710#p171710).

**Execute phase (< 20%)**:
- Dec-2024 kit (refund): "time the Executes ... swing and then use Execute ... then Precision Cut will give back tons, and then either do it again ... or wait for another swing and then Execute again" [Wolf of Rage (player), 2025-03-18](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=122923#p122923). Use Recklessness / racial here.
- CC3 kit (base-damage Precision Cut) per staff: "shift ideal play to incentivize spending a swing's generated rage with other abilities, before spending the remaining on Execute" [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159). Licata's measured damage-per-rage: Execute surplus ~26 dmg/rage vs Mortal Strike ~45 and Slam ~70 in his gear — "Unless you're about to start overcapping your rage or the target is dying right NOW it's better to use Slam, even during the only time Execute is available" [Licata (player), 2026-01-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166667#p166667). Practical rule he gives: at high rage from a white hit, cast Slam first, then Execute, so the next swing refunds you.
- 1.18.1 kit (25/50/75% per extra rage): dev intent is a "high-impact finisher"; Licata computes the 1.18.1 version still below Slam per rage. **Contested / untested post-release**: no post after 2026-03-20 reports Arms execute-phase results. Bots: Execute only at high rage (≥ ~60–100), Slam/MS otherwise.

rotationAoe.heading: Multi-target / AoE
rotationAoe.markdown:
- **2–3 targets**: Sweeping Strikes (20 rage) then Whirlwind and Cleave: "a good opening move in the dungeons is to charge into sweeping strikes into berserker stance into whirlwind. on 3 mobs whirlwind under sweeping strikes will give you 6 white swings worth of damage. be mindful of threat though" [Shaman111 (player), 2023-09-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=64562#p64562); "Sweeping Strikes + Cleave, and later level Sweeping Strikes + Whirlwind. You pull 2 mobs for that and watch them die" [Unangwata (player), 2020-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=8309#p8309). Sweeping Strikes copies only damage, not ability effects/threat modifiers, and its 5 hits burn fast on weak hits [Atreidon (player), 2026-02-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167790#p167790).
- **4+ targets**: same; Whirlwind hit detection is sometimes flaky ("Sometimes when I Whirlwind it doesn't register that the mobs are close together" [Pauly (player), 2022-09-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=25872#p25872)). No 4+ specific priority in the sources.
- Do not Sweeping-Strike/Whirlwind near CC; Deep Wounds bleeds break Intimidating Shout (Syrathegreat, above).

cooldowns.heading: Cooldowns and resources
cooldowns.markdown:
- Sweeping Strikes at the start of every AoE pull (Wolf of Rage); Recklessness in execute phase; Death Wish if taken; Retaliation only if the build dips Improved Disciplines (rarely: "useless Improved Disciplines there, which no one takes" [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2023-06-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=51132#p51132)).
- Rage: Arms generates rage once per white swing; after an Execute you may sit at 0 with nothing to do "like a level 14 warrior" (Licata). Bloodrage (10 rage) is not enough for Slam/Execute. Conserve rage between dungeon pulls: "try to conserve rage between pulls" (Shaman111, above).
- Master Strike: 20 rage, 30 s; needs the right weapon type, and swapping weapons "retriggering the gcd and resetting the swing timer" (Licata). Bots: only use the effect of the currently equipped weapon (axe root by default); do not swap mid-combat.

roleStrategy.heading: Role strategy
roleStrategy.markdown:
- Behind the boss; Sunder for the raid; Battle Shout; Pummel interrupts in Berserker Stance.
- Off-tank duty with Sweeping Strikes when adds come (Kara40 add fights — Ellifta).
- Dungeon tanking as Arms: see `leveling.md` (Tactical Mastery + Improved Thunder Clap; 2H tank with a shield in bags for hard bosses).
- Threat awareness: Arms has bursty cleave; the classic complaint is cleave pulling adds off tanks.

gear.heading: Gear, enchants and consumables
gear.markdown: Same sources as the Fury playbook. 2H-specific: "There is also the added benefit of UTB/BRE being near bis and available right away from mc and the first boss in bwl" [Econrel (player), 2024-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=100900#p100900); BRE PPM 3→2 [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105276#p105276); Untamed Blade damage raised in 1.18.1 [Dragunovi (staff), 2026-02-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=168272#p168272); Might of Menethil is the feared PvP 2H ("a t3 arms warrior with might of menethil means anyone else may as well not even play" [Ninetyone (player), 2024-12-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=114483#p114483)); Runeblade of Baron Rivendare vs Dal'Rend swords question got only trinket answers (Hand of Justice, Rune of the Guard Captain, Blackhand's Breadth) [Steakhouse (player), 2025-02-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=119537#p119537); Towerforge Demolisher considered as a buyable 2H [Boblin (player), 2025-05-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=132704#p132704); +2H mace weapon-skill item coming in 1.17.2 and Ashkin Belt [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-06-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=49836#p49836). Kara40: Dreadslayer mini-set + 3p T3.5 (Noephix, Fury playbook). Consumables/enchants: gap.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown:
- Playing 2H with deep Fury talents and no Improved Slam / 2H spec ("2h fury isnt a spec anymore. If you use twohanders go arms" — Atreidon; contested but the underlying advice — take the Arms 2H talents — is consensus).
- Not casting Slam right after the swing / casting it just before a swing (loses white damage) — Wolf of Rage, marvian.
- Executing yourself to 0 rage mid-rotation (Licata) — do Slam/MS first, Execute last.
- Heroic Strike as filler.
- Weapon-swapping for Master Strike in raids.
- Using Rend at 60 in raids — Rend is "obnoxiously weak and not worth buffing" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); it is a leveling/PvP tool (it does scale with 0.15 AP per Ivgas, above).
- Cleaving/Whirlwinding CC'd mobs; Sweeping Strikes on the wrong pack.

extraSections.heading: Official kit (staff)
extraSections.markdown:
- CC2 [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974): Tactical Mastery to row 1; Improved Rend 2 pts (10/20%); Deflection to row 2; Improved Charge 5/10 rage; **Deep Wounds ticks every 1.5 s for 6 s**; Improved Hamstring removed; new keystone Counterattack (later replaced); **Improved Slam moved to Arms** (2 pts, also reduces Slam's GCD); **Two-Handed Weapon Specialization 3 pts, 2/4/6% damage and +1/2/3 skill in all two-handed weapons**; Poleaxe/Sword spec replaced by **Master of Arms** (5 pts; Axe +1–5% crit, Mace ignore armor per level, Sword 1–5% extra attack, Polearm +0.4–2.0 yd range); **Sweeping Strikes 20 rage, not spent by off-hand hits**; new Precision Cut and Boundless Anger; Improved Disciplines −4/8/12 min; Slam taught at 14; Pummel in Battle Stance; Rend scales with AP.
- 2024-11-01 [Dragunovi (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=105804#p105804): Rend 5% AP per tick; Mortal Strike 105/110/115/120% weapon damage (instead of +flat); Slam 2 s; Decisive Strike 2.5 s.
- 2024-12-20 [Jamey (staff)](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460): Decisive Strike removed; **Slam 2.5 s cast, continues swing timer, castable while moving, ranks 50–90% weapon damage**; "those with 3.8s weapons should see about a -18% damage nerf"; Master of Arms mace penetration 1.2–6 per level (360 at 60); Precision Cut → 10/20/30% rage refund; Execute back to vanilla values, 4.5 s cooldown; Mortal Strike buff reverted; "Arms is mostly in a good spot right now. We've tried to push Arms into the more precise and calculated gameplay design".

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.markdown:
Covers the three leveling approaches the forum actually argues about: **2H Arms** (the majority recommendation), **dual-wield Fury** (the alternative that became viable with Class Changes 2 and Blood Drinker/Blood Craze), and **Protection via dungeons** (recommended against by most, defended by a few). Sources span 2022–2026 and three kit versions; every recommendation names its kit.

All dates UTC. Eras: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). Kit versions inside pre-1.18.1: pre-CC2 (before 2024-11-01), CC2 (1.17.2, 2024-11-01: new rage formula, dual wield at level 10, Slam at 14, Hamstring 6 s cooldown, talent trees rebuilt [Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102974#p102974)), the 2024-12-20 revision (Decisive Strike removed, Slam 2.5 s cast usable while moving [Jamey (staff), 2024-12-20](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113460#p113460)), CC3 (1.18.0, 2025-08-15: Master Strike, Blood Drinker rework, Execute cooldown removed [Jamey (staff), 2025-07-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=141159#p141159)), 1.18.1 (Hamstring cooldown removed [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071)).

sections.heading: Which spec — the argument
sections.markdown:
- **2H Arms (majority, all eras)**: "Arms is honestly the best way to level if you want to do so as dps" [Mazeperception (player), 2022-02-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=16543#p16543); "You shouldn't be dual wielding while leveling. Not enough hit gear. Go 2hand arms and you'll melt stuff with a half decent weapon. The new rage formula works great for leveling I steam rolled to 60 with a 2 hander" [Grizb37 (player), 2025-08-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=144945#p144945); "Fury was never a way to level. At least not until like 50-ish levels, when you can get some thrashing weapons and a bit of a hit gear" [armsgirl (player), 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149087#p149087); "Main selling point for Arms is Sweeping Strikes which turns you into an aoe machine and a great dungeon tank. Also Bloodthirst scales with AP which you usually don't have much while leveling. MS on the other hand scales with weapon damage" [Khagrim (player), 2024-11-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107379#p107379); "Level 40 and a decent amount of crit. If you don't have that much, then arms will be better" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149483#p149483).
- **DW Fury (minority pre-CC2, growing after CC2/CC3)**: "I enjoy leveling warr as fury. I would even challenge that it is slower than arms. Also makes it easier to tank in dungeons" [Zulnam (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60478#p60478); "I leveled DW from 20-50 and had a good time ... I definitely had more rage to spend" [Pistol (player), 2022-11-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=28473#p28473); "My basic advice for leveling is choose Fury. The most important talents are about longevity and reducing downtime, and that means Blood Craze. You're getting critted every fight; 6% back makes a real difference" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); "Fury is absolutely the way to go if you are solo and can get a decent mainhand. Blooddrinker is insane for solo leveling once you hit 35+" [Soreb (player), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149364#p149364); "Since the offhand +10 hit talent early in Fury tree, theres no reason not to" [Kerenis (player), 2026-02-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167721#p167721); "while arms is fun, imo fury is way faster due to blood craze + blood drinker" [amanagor (player), 2026-03-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173445#p173445) (post-1.18.1); "Arms or fury are both fine for leveling, and DW definitely has some advantages in terms of mitigating lost damage from avoidance, and in feeding you overpower procs" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-09-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151373#p151373). The hit problem stated numerically: DW "adds a 19% chance to miss on both hands, combined with the base 5%, that's 24%" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147408#p147408); counter: "You can counter it by doing green quests" [Xudo (player), 2025-08-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=147440#p147440).
- **2H Fury for leveling**: "As of the recent patch leveling 2h fury is pretty pointless, the class changes basically deleted the playstyle" [Turbosaxophonic (player), 2024-11-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106806#p106806) (CC2); after CC3 the Slam build exists at 60 (see `fury-melee-dps.md`) and one HC leveler uses Slam a lot: "Find yourself a slow 2h weapon and use slam in your rotation a lot" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895). Contested.
- **Protection (dungeon leveling)** — **contested, majority against**: "Do not level as a Prot Warrior ... Prior to raids, you do not need to be Prot in order to tank well" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37550#p37550); "Ignore the protection talent tree ... your spells baseline are plenty good enough to tank anything before raids no matter your spec" [Kairion (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60459#p60459); "Taking 2 times as long to do quests as i was doing on arms was not fun at all" [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911); "Prot isn't actually a good tank while levelling in Classic ... Arms becomes the best levelling tank spec due to talents like tactical mastery and improved thunderclap" [Syrathegreat (player), 2024-03-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=90022#p90022); "You can but it's slow. I did it by spamming dungeons ... Prepare for not having threat around lvl 50-54" [Akos1896 (player), 2024-03-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=89977#p89977). For: "This is best spec to level warri if you wanna go dungeons ... You will have Shield Wall and Last Stand for a critical situation" [Bloodline1x9 (player), 2023-03-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37690#p37690) (HC, turtle glyph); "Prot is actually a decent leveler right now, and you get insta queue pops being a tank" [Drazenexe (player), 2025-12-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=164108#p164108); post-1.18.1 the tree still gets called a leveling weak spot: "Shield Specialization does not generate enough rage to make it on par with Duel Wielding or 2H Warriors" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175303#p175303).
- **"Any spec works"** (post-CC2 consensus tone): "Both Arms and Fury are good for leveling and have no problem tanking leveling dungeons" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=173980#p173980); "you can level in any spec u want ... would reccomend to switch around at like level 40 and use some gold to respecc" [Morkahja (player), 2026-02-07](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=167706#p167706); "Warriors went from one of the worst leveling class to near one of best with recent rage changes. I'm getting like 40 rage after charging and one hitting the mob with a white weapon at level 27" [Grizb37 (player), 2024-12-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=112520#p112520).

sections.heading: Build A — 2H Arms (default), talent order 10–60
sections.markdown:
The only level-by-level route in the sources (CC3 tree, written for 1.18.0; the 1.18.1 changes do not touch these talents except the Boundless Anger/Precision Cut swap, which is a 60 concern): [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157920#p157920), build link to 40 `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=DQCDKYDIp-Ao-` (opaque):

| Order | Talent | Points | Reaches at (5 pts/row logic; levels are the reader's arithmetic — the post gives order only) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Cruelty (Fury) | 5/5 | ~level 14 |
| 2 | Tactical Mastery (Arms) | 3/5 | ~17 |
| 3 | Improved Rend (Arms) | 2/2 | ~19 |
| 4 | Improved Thunder Clap (Arms) | 3/3 | ~22 |
| 5 | Deflection (Arms) | 2/5 | ~24 |
| 6 | Improved Overpower (Arms) | 2/2 | ~26 |
| 7 | Dual Wield Specialization (Fury) | 3/3 as written | ~29 |
| 8 | Two-Handed Weapon Specialization (Arms) | 3/3 as written | ~32 |
| 9 | Impale (Arms) | 1/2 | ~33 |
| 10 | Master Strike (Arms) | 1/1 | ~34 |
| 11 | Sweeping Strikes (Arms) | 1/1 | ~35 |
| 12 | Master of Arms (Arms) | 5/5 | ~40 |

(The "3/3" for Dual Wield Specialization and Two-Handed Weapon Specialization is how the post writes it; the route mixes DW and 2H talents on purpose — "Then if you want to go 2H you switch" to a 60 build. Rank maxima are not restated here because the CC2 tree changed several rank counts; check the calculator.) Hctwowfan's tweak to the same build: "0/5 in improved shouts and instead put those into 2/2 improved slam and 3/3 blood craze" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895).

Other Arms leveling links (opaque, CC2 era): Yasara's "classic armsbuild for leveling" `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=DQFARYDQpYAABABoAoBYAoAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` with Overpower and Counterattack ranked up [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095) (Counterattack no longer exists — CC3); Czasku's Arms-to-30 `...?points=FQFAQYAQAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA%3D` [Czasku (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106723#p106723).

Talent notes: Tactical Mastery is what makes early tanking work — "You would start Arms if you plan to tank early because it grabs tac mastery and imp tclap. Those two talents will be 90% of your ability to tank for a good while" [Eyeburn (player), 2025-09-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151619#p151619); "TacMastery lets you do stuff like Charge -> Def stance -> ThunderClap -> Demo Shout" [Oomentaloo (player), 2025-09-08](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=150752#p150752). Axe Specialization at 30 is why the Whirlwind Axe is the pick: "at lvl 30 you can take Axe Specialization which is additional 5% ... When you're lvl 40 you get Mortal Strike" [Czasku (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101834#p101834) — note Master of Arms replaced the per-weapon specializations at CC2, so this is pre-CC2 reasoning; the axe's top-end damage argument still holds ("the axe has the highest top dmg" [Hctwowfan (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101830#p101830); damage ranges per Whirlwind weapon [Atreidon (player), 2024-09-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=101831#p101831)).

sections.heading: Build B — DW Fury (from ~level 10, or switch at 40–50)
sections.markdown:
Sourced talents (Berettadin, CC2 era; Blood Drinker per Soreb/amanagor, CC3+): "Cruelty 5/5, Dual Wield Specialization 5/5, Blood Craze 3/3, Improved Shouts 5/5, (Demoralizing Shout is a staple and you're reducing damage taken), and Enrage 5/5. After that ... for PvE leveling Flurry is excellent. On the Arms side Improved Heroic Strike helps since HS is your primary rage spender. Improved Rend is a talent tax ... Tactical Mastery is only worth 1 thing: having enough Rage for Disarm ... Improved Overpower is actually quite nice since you'll generate a lot of enemy Dodges" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489). Add Blood Drinker 3/3 at 35+ ("insane for solo leveling once you hit 35+" [Soreb (player), 2025-08-30](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149364#p149364)) — order not given (gap). Bloodthirst at 40. The 60 DW link (opaque): `https://talents.turtlecraft.gg/warrior?points=dQQACYAQ-AoFAoAAoZCFAB-` [armsgirl (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157920#p157920). Unbridled Wrath is skipped by DW levelers ("Duel Wield Specialization provides significantly more rage" [SvenS2 (player), 2026-04-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=175303#p175303)); "Unbridled Wrath really only shines when dual wielding daggers" [Hctwowfan (player), 2025-10-31](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=157895#p157895).

Weapons: "main hand weapons of 2.8+ speed" [armsgirl (player), 2025-08-29](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=149087#p149087); a slow main hand ("fury just needs to prioritize strength and a slow mainhand" [Armet (player), 2024-01-17](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=84970#p84970)).

sections.heading: Respec points
sections.markdown:
- Level ~30: Arms → Prot if you commit to dungeon tanking [Czasku (player), 2024-11-06](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=106723#p106723); Zhilo tried Prot at 30 and went back [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911).
- Level 40: Mortal Strike/Bloodthirst; Arms → DW Fury if you have crit (Eyeburn p=149483) or Fury → try the other spec (Morkahja p=167706); armsgirl's route ends at 40 and switches to a 60-style build.
- Level ~50: DW Fury becomes viable with hit gear even for Arms-leaning posters (armsgirl p=149087).
- 60: pick the raid build (`fury-melee-dps.md`, `arms-melee-dps.md`, `protection-tank.md`). Respec is cheap: "The respec cap is pretty cheap on Turtle" [Zhilo (player), 2023-03-15](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=37911#p37911) (no number given; gap).

sections.heading: Skill training priority (what to skip when poor)
sections.markdown:
- "Warrior is an expensive class. Heavier armor costs more to repair. You have more weapon skills to train then anyone" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489).
- Rank-1-only list: "If you are short on gold, you can learn only first rank of following skills: Hamstring, Overpower, Thunderclap, Mocking blow, Intercept, Shield Bash, Pummel. Additional ranks add more damage, but don't increase utility" [Xudo (player), 2023-02-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36342#p36342). Caveat: "caution when only learning rank 1 thunderclap for tanking. The reason why its so good for tanking is because it has a threat multiplier on its damage ... try to not skimp on tclap ranks" [Kairion (player), 2023-02-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=36357#p36357); Improved Thunder Clap increases its damage (101 → 123/141/162) [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=42540#p42540). Overpower ranks matter more now that Improved Overpower is in every Arms route — the rank-1 list predates CC2.
- Slam at 14 costs more than expected: "it's not a big loss if you don't train it, since it is worth using only with a very slow weapon to dump rage, heroic strike will do better in any case at lower levels" [Macbetto (player), 2025-01-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=115543#p115543) (before the 2025-07 Slam buffs).
- Always train: Sunder Armor, Rend, Heroic Strike (max ranks), Battle Shout, Demoralizing Shout, Charge, Bloodrage, Berserker Rage, stances, Execute, Mortal Strike/Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Cleave (dungeons). Shield Bash is the best low-level tank opener: "Shield Bash generates 180 bonus threat at all levels ... for only 10 rage" [Redmagejoe (player), 2023-05-27](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47619#p47619) (drops off 34+).
- Weapon skills: train all; "anything other than Human, Orc, or Goblin will require weapon skill items at endgame" [Syrathegreat (player), 2023-05-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=47323#p47323) (pre-CC2; CC2 smoothed weapon skill — "these are subject to change in the upcoming major patch, so i would not choose a human warrior now for the weapon skill racial alone" [Zulnam (player), 2024-10-13](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=103027#p103027)).

sections.heading: Playstyle
sections.markdown:
- Opener (2H Arms): "charge -> sunder amor (which is often better than heroic strike) -> rend and sunder armor again ... Overpower is very OP and it proccs really often ... keep your Battle Shout up" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108095#p108095); DW Fury: "Opening is Rend, Demoralizing Shout, Sunder Armor, and HS when you can afford it" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489); Execute is situational ("starting a new fight ... with 0 rage and charge on CD is lame" — Yasara).
- **Hamstring kiting — contested**: for: "Art of arms leveling is in hamstring kiting. You charge+hamstring, deal melee hit and run from slowed mob while your attack is recharging ... ~30% reduction of incoming damage" [Xudo (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108097#p108097); "Use a slow twohander, apply hamstring, kite the slowed mob until your next autoattack is ready, apply sunder armor as you deal the autoattack, bandage if needed, repeat" [Borefficz (player), 2023-09-01](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=60465#p60465); [Turbosaxophonic (player), 2024-12-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=113433#p113433) (Charge > Hamstring > auto > strafe > Rend). Against: "Hamstring kiting is great against higher level opponents but completely unsuitable for normal leveling ... combat duration x 3 but incoming damage - 20%" [Yasara (player), 2024-11-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=108106#p108106). Note: written during the 6 s Hamstring cooldown era; the cooldown is gone since 1.18.1.
- Mob selection: "Try to do quests where the enemys are 2-3 levels below your own level ... sections.heading: Common mistakes
sections.markdown:
- Dual wielding early without hit gear (Grizb37, Mazeperception, armsgirl).
- Going deep Protection before 60 for solo questing (Redmagejoe, Kairion, Zhilo).
- Fighting yellow/orange mobs or 2+ at once (Yasara, Monmothma21, Tacticalnelf).
- Letting the weapon fall behind (Yasara, Monmothma21).
- Skipping First Aid/Cooking (Berettadin).
- Copying pre-CC2 talent lists (Xudo p=28808, Kobemaru, Wilsonsds) into the CC2/CC3 tree.
- Forgetting Hamstring on runners ("besides forgetting to Hamstring things that run off and come back with friends there's not a lot to go wrong" [Berettadin (player), 2025-05-10](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=130489#p130489)).

name: Priest
summary: Priests on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 have three distinct jobs:
overview:
Priests on Turtle WoW 1.18.1 have three distinct jobs:

- **Holy** is a top-tier raid healer after the final patch.
- **Discipline** is a custom Holy-damage **Smite** DPS spec, and the best way to level.
- **Shadow** is a support DPS that every raid wants one of, for Shadow Weaving and Vampiric Embrace, even though its damage sits at the bottom of the meters.

**New player recommendation:** level as Smite (wand, Spirit Tap, Holy, then Discipline; see [Leveling](#/class/priest/leveling)). At 60, pick Holy to heal or Smite/Shadow to DPS.

stats.heading: Stat priority and caps
stats.markdown: 1. **Healing power** until you reach roughly 1,000. With just under 1k healing power, Flash Heal, Renew and Prayer of Healing are "more then enough" Istrefi · 2026-04-15. 2. **Spell crit.** Inspiration and 150% crit heals favour it [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). 3. **Intellect**, then **Spirit**, then **mp5**, then **Stamina** (same source). Spirit converts to healing through Spiritual Guidance and to regen. Lirya's comparison: +30 Spirit food beats +8 mp5 food Lirya · 2026-03-26. 4. **Haste**: take cheap sources such as haste food and Juju. They matter for landing heals before other healers snipe them ("the difference between 1.1s and 1.2s flash is very real") t0uchm3 · 2026-02-13. Haste sources multiply with each other, and anything that pushes a cast below the 1.5 s GCD is wasted 30 · 2026-02-26, 30 · 2026-02-26. Caps: healing has none. Spell hit only matters for dispels and offensive spells. Useful numbers (tested in-game): - **Coefficients** after the 15% nerf: Renew 0.857, Heal 0.857, Greater Heal 1.0, Flash Heal 0.433, Prayer of Healing 0.433, Lesser Heal 0.433, Power Word: Shield 0.35 Mithreon · 2026-01-26. With 5/5 Spiritual Healing, Renew scales at about 1.12× healing power L-star · 2026-02-27. - **Power Word: Shield** = `942 × (1 + 0.15 Improved PW:S + 0.2 Force of Will) + healing power × 0.35`. The shield talents raise only the base value L-star · 2025-10-13, L-star · 2025-10-13. - A reference Kara40-tier healer reaches about 920 healing and 100-105 mp5 unbuffed #priest.

rotationSingle.heading: Single-target healing (priority list)
rotationSingle.markdown: Target priority: you, then the tank, then the other healers, then DPS [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). 1. **Target about to die, and no time for a cast:** cast `Power Word: Shield`, then heal [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). Exception: on warrior and bear tanks, shield only before the pull or in a real emergency. An absorbed hit gives them no rage, roughly 12 rage lost per 1,000 absorbed Duciel · 2025-10-10, [Akos1896, 2025-09-25](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=153177#p153177). 2. **Tank taking heavy damage, or anyone near half health:** `Flash Heal` rank 7 Istrefi · 2026-04-15, Istrefi · 2026-04-10. 3. **Big damage you know is coming (tank buster, enrage):** precast `Greater Heal` rank 1 Istrefi · 2026-04-10. With 8/8 T2, Greater Heal spam is also the tool for steady raid damage (see Gear). 4. **Tanks:** keep `Renew` (max rank) up at all times Istrefi · 2026-04-10. "Always Be cRenewing" Tzychotic · 2026-02-13. 5. **Anyone with a small amount of missing health:** `Flash Heal` rank 1 Istrefi · 2026-04-15. 6. **Between every heal:** cast `Renew` rank 1 on a raid member, or on yourself when nobody needs it, so the next heal is a different spell and Book of Prayer refunds mana Istrefi · 2026-04-10, Bluefear · 2026-03-20. Do not warp your healing to chase refunds. Heal normally and let them happen 30 · 2026-03-27. 7. **Mana conservation:** keep raiders at 80-90% instead of 100%. The missing 10-20% almost never causes a death Daimonoz · 2025-10-17. On a tank you are pre-healing, start the big heal and cancel it at about two-thirds of the cast bar if it is not needed. This keeps you inside long 5-second-rule regen windows Greendam · 2026-04-06. **Contested: Greater Heal's place.** Lirya calls Greater Heal "niche" in 1.18.1, with Prayer of Healing stronger where Greater Heal used to shine Lirya · 2026-03-27. Others keep 8/8 T2 Greater Heal spam for constant-damage fights such as Sapphiron and the first Kara40 boss Klurifax · 2026-03-22, 30 · 2025-12-28. t0uchm3 sees Flash Heal + Renew staying the foundation, with Prayer of Healing strong but not replacing it t0uchm3 · 2026-03-21.

roleStrategy.heading: Role duties
roleStrategy.markdown: - **Dispels:** use Rinse or a similar addon. Nefarian's Mind Control showed up as a dispellable "buff", so blind dispel spam can strip allies' buffs L-star · 2025-10-18. - **Buffs:** keep Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Shadow Protection (on shadow fights) up. Avoid buffing tanks, ret paladins and enhancement shamans with extras they do not need. They hit the 32-slot visible buff cap, and a toggled buff pushed into the hidden slots can get stuck on until relog Greendam · 2025-11-05. - **Proactive healing:** pre-HoT and pre-cast on predicted damage instead of reacting. Paladins can spam and druids HoT, so a priest who only reacts gets sniped Pyronus · 2026-03-16.

Kara40 has no healing weapon upgrade Greendam · 2025-11-05. Staff of the Dreamer ranks above Benediction, Rod of Resuscitation and the AQ20 exalted staff HolyScheiss · 2025-06-07. - **Trinkets:** Hazza'rah's Charm of Healing ("extremely good to use on CD") and Breath of Solnius (Emerald Sanctum hard mode; healing power plus a haste proc) IllegallyParkedFrog · 2025-10-22. Breath's "Fever Dream" proc is about 20% haste and is BiS for Greater Heal spam Fragui · 2026-02-12. The **Scarab Brooch** procs an absorb shield off any heal, including Prayer of Healing ("insanely good") Greendam · 2026-03-26. It is great on Loatheb and mostly overheal elsewhere Snackz · 2026-03-26. - **Loop of Infused Renewal** (Greater Heal can proc a free Renew): **Contested.** One tester measured it about 20% better than a T3 ring on Greater Heal spam fights t0uchm3 · 2026-02-25. L-star disputes its value L-star · 2026-02-25. - **Mana items:** Loatheb ring, Rapid Evolution gloves, Maexxna neck, Gnarlmoon cloak, the Emerald Sanctum staff and neck, and Sandals of Inner Peace (BoE) Greendam · 2025-12-14.

mistakes.heading: Common mistakes
mistakes.markdown: - Shielding warrior or bear tanks on pull (you deny their rage) Duciel · 2025-10-10. - Taking 2/2 Empowered Recovery (the second point adds nothing) Blossom · 2026-04-06. - Alternating ranks of the same spell for Book of Prayer (only different spells count) Bluefear · 2026-03-20. - Counting on Power Word: Shield or Holy Nova to trigger Book of Prayer Snackz · 2026-03-19, Aeterna/Hanayanagi · 2026-03-23. - Following Proclaim Champion or clickable-Lightwell advice (removed or reworked in 1.18.1) Dreamhaze · 2026-01-24. - Casting Holy Nova during Nefarian's priest class call Soundless · 2026-04-13. - Topping everyone to 100%: overhealing burns the mana you need later Daimonoz · 2025-10-17.

extraSections.heading: Mana management
extraSections.markdown: - Heal in bursts, then stop casting so the 5-second rule regen can tick Duciel · 2025-06-01. - Take a Major Mana Potion early in long fights so the next one is ready in time. Tea and Dark or Demonic Runes share a cooldown [Langorn, 2025-09-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=152325#p152325). - **Contested: 3-piece T2 (15% regen while casting).** It is dead weight once your raid is fast and you finish fights with mana left t0uchm3 · 2026-03-31. It remains worth it on long, constant-damage fights t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. - If you run out on long Kara40 fights, swap in Pendant of Forgotten Names and Ring of Spiritual Fervor (+20% regen while casting each) Fragui · 2026-03-31. - **Downranking:** at endgame you mostly cast max ranks. Downranking belongs to late leveling and a fresh 60 Greendam · 2026-04-18. When you do downrank, Heal rank 2+, Greater Heal rank 1+ and Renew rank 3+ keep full scaling [Sharmaine, 2025-12-02](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=161280#p161280).

extraSections.heading: Macros and addons
extraSections.markdown: - **Healing frames:** Puppeteer (click-casting, heal prediction; the usual beginner pick) IllegallyParkedFrog · 2025-10-22, pfUI raid frames, or Luna Unit Frames Greendam · 2026-04-18. For Prayer of Healing prediction across groups, use t0uchm3's HealComm fix or MarcelineVQ's updated Luna t0uchm3 · 2026-03-25. - **Mouseover:** SuperWoW + SuperCleveRoidMacros for `[@mouseover]` Greendam · 2025-10-04. Example: `/cast [@mouseover help] Flash Heal;[@target help] Flash Heal;[@player] Flash Heal` Zitronenhaze - BUFF SPRIEST · 2026-01-03. - **QuickHeal** (auto-target and rank): needs SuperWoW + UnitXP and does not work alongside Nampower's queue Greendam · 2026-02-13. Its fork adds Prayer of Healing group targeting (`/qh poh`) Demontap · 2026-03-28. - **Rinse** for dispels Istrefi · 2026-04-18; **LazyRes** for mass resurrection Greendam · 2025-11-22. Do not trust the TheoryCraft addon's priest coefficients on Turtle Greendam · 2025-10-16.

extraSections.heading: Dungeon and raid notes
extraSections.markdown: - **Nefarian (BWL), priest class call:** only Renew and Power Word: Shield are safe Istrefi · 2026-03-20. Holy Nova counts as direct healing and can kill people, including you Soundless · 2026-04-13. - **Firemaw (BWL):** healers stand at max range. Holy Reach and positioning matter Istrefi · 2026-03-19. - **Anomalus (Kara40):** 8/8 T2 Greater Heal works well, but T2 alone cannot reach the Arcane Resistance floor. One recipe reaches 183 AR with enchanted head, legs, rings, cloak and neck plus a druid buff t0uchm3 · 2026-01-09. - **Sapphiron (Naxxramas):** a constant-damage fight where 3-piece T2 shines t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. Renew does not trigger the fight's heal debuff t0uchm3 · 2026-03-22. - **Loatheb (Naxxramas):** Scarab Brooch Snackz · 2026-03-26.

extraSections.heading: Bugs and quirks
extraSections.markdown: - After a respec, especially through the dual-spec device, Spiritual Healing can silently stop applying to Renew (and possibly other heals), making them noticeably weaker than expected. Deleting the WDB cache folder fixes it 🐹 hamster 🐹 · 2026-02-27, L-star · 2026-02-27. - Buff tooltips do not update for talents or set bonuses. The spellbook numbers are the accurate ones Valaen · 2026-03-21.

sections.markdown: What the sources do not settle: 1. **Tauren racial numbers.** The exact damage, mana costs and durations of Light of An'she and Spiritwalker, and when the second racial unlocks, are unknown MonthOLDpickle · 2026-04-18. 2. **Smite T1 5-piece bonus.** A tooltip screenshot says 30% pushback avoidance; another player describes +35 spell power with Inner Fire meowww · 2026-03-20, LaZy · 2026-03-21. 3. **Lightwell after the hotfix.** Whether the Splendor of Light targeting fix (2026-03-24) cured the "heals full-HP players" bug reported in April L-star · 2026-04-02. 4. **Shadow Weaving.** Whether the 9 s debuff duration is intended, and how several Shadow priests' stacks interact Liddy · 2026-03-21, irotos · 2026-03-08. 5. **Full per-slot enchant lists for Smite, Shadow and PvP.** Only healer lists and a few DPS slots (shoulders, wrist, weapon, gloves) are sourced. The stats of the Naxx shoulder enchant are not stated. 6. **Renew rank 5.** Whether this rank, inefficient before 1.18.1, was fixed; 1.18.1 only names Heal rank 4 and Flash Heal ranks 3-7. 7. **Sigil of the Ancient Accord for Shadow** stays disputed Ydr · 2026-03-25, and so does Mark of the Champion vs Eye of Dormant Corruption against Undead Mendeleev · 2026-04-17. 8. **PvP after 1.18.1.** `#pvp-general` ends in 2025-11, so the matchups are pre-release apart from a handful of post-release `#priest` posts. Per-spec dampening values are unknown. 9. **Holy vs 21/30 hybrid throughput** in 1.18.1: no parse comparison was posted. 10. **Leveling zone route.** No priest-specific route exists. The dungeon table is limited to instances named for priest loot. 11. **Book of Prayer and T2 8-piece.** Whether the 8-piece's extra "Renew" counts as a separate spell for Book of Prayer #priest.
